forWhat: The timetable's rules for a class. Set when periods start and end, which days are blocked, which slots are fixed, and the fewest and most periods of a subject. Every change is kept with who made it.

layout.shows: [[Block a day]], which takes you to the blocked days.
Each block with its reason, and a form to add one.
Each limit, how many periods are placed now, and a form to set one.
The slots the school pinned, by week and weekday, and a form to pin one.
Each period's name and times, and the last changes with who made them.

jobs.title: Block a day
steps: Pick the date, or a weekday, and say why in [[Reason]].
Press [[Block]]. Nothing will be placed on that day or period.

jobs.title: Change the most periods of a subject
steps: Under the limits, pick the subject and week or fortnight.
Type the fewest, the most, or both, then press [[Save limit]].

buttons.label: Block a day
buttons.does: Takes you to the form that blocks a day or a period.
buttons.doesNot: It does not block anything by itself.

buttons.label: Block
buttons.does: Saves the block and keeps who made it.
buttons.doesNot: It does not move lessons yet.

buttons.label: Save limit
buttons.does: Saves the fewest and most for that subject.
buttons.doesNot: It does not rebuild the timetable yet.
